claim_boundaries: models remain loaded across the declared stage sequence
each fingerprint switch starts a fresh fail-closed epoch
Phase 5 controller uses fresh epochs only
post-stage replay is excluded from service timing
full-selective mode evaluates the declared risk policy
long-horizon fingerprints include duration, session age, accumulated audio, prefix/input bounds, service mode, and the intermediate and terminal canonical authorities
distinct-sequence audio concatenates distinct utterances with silence and never uses sample-level roll or repetition
risk is statistical state-entry disagreement, not bitwise determinism
a verified canonical draw that differs on a later replay is reported as replay non-repeatability, not as an online selection-authority violation or an unverified fast-path counterexample
static-oracle thresholds are frozen from prior independent split-sample certificates and supply performance references
episode-specific stream identities and audio offsets prevent exact episode replay from being counted as fresh evidence
certified terminal revisions suppress discarded proposer work when the corresponding flag is enabled
post-stage replay evidence is not used for adaptation
the canonical dtype is a versioned service reference and is not claimed to reproduce the official BF16 trajectory
